description: Use this when someone wants a timed itinerary for Kamakura and Enoshima on a given date: one day (full day from Kita-Kamakura to the Great Buddha, half day, or Hase plus Enoshima island) or two days with a night in Kamakura, starting from Tokyo Station, Shinjuku, Shinagawa or Yokohama. Returns every train, walk and visit with clock times, opening-time waits, train fares and entry fees per adult (and per child if children come), walking time, that day's crowd level, holiday and bloom season, and shows a route map card. All inputs are optional. Examples: "Plan a day in Kamakura from Tokyo next Saturday." / "We have two days for Kamakura and Enoshima from Shinjuku in June. What should we do?"

children.description: Children aged 6 to 11, for child entry fees and Enoden child fares (default 0).

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD (or "today", "tomorrow"), 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31. Default: next Saturday.

days.description: 1 (default) or 2 (two days with one night in Kamakura: Kita-Kamakura, the shrine and the bamboo temple, then Hase and Enoshima).

leave.description: Time of the first train as HH:MM, 05:00 to 14:00 (default 07:45).

route.description: One-day route: full (default: Kita-Kamakura Zen temples, Tsurugaoka Hachimangu, Komachi-dori, Great Buddha, Hasedera), half (Great Buddha, Hasedera, Komachi-dori, Tsurugaoka Hachimangu) or enoshima (Great Buddha, Hasedera, then Enoshima island: shrine, Sea Candle, caves).

start.description: Where the day starts: tokyo (Tokyo Station), shinjuku, shinagawa or yokohama. Default tokyo.

name: plan_day
